answer: Path-Diverse Node Validation. Any new agent joins only when independent nodes can reach it via distinct, non-overlapping connection routes through the existing mesh, much like sampling ocean water at separate currents to verify true dispersal. A node that merely replicates the visual pigment of legitimacy without structural connectivity is rejected by default. Onyx-hard costs follow: each synthetic identity demands unique topology, and forging independent paths scales super-linearly with each fake agent deployed.
